#JavaScript bindings: coverage

Generated by src/tools/bindgen (package jsgen) from the Web IDL of the specifications (native/js/webref, see VERSION) and the browser's API (api/*.widl). An interface is exposed when something of it is implemented (or it is the interface of a node); the others exist in the engine but are absent from the global object unless javascript.bindings.expose_unimplemented is on. A member not implemented is absent (javascript.bindings.unimplemented = absent, the default: feature detection sees it missing) or throws NotSupportedError (throw).

How a member is implemented: C hand-written (native/js/runtime), import a browser function of api/*.widl (the glue is generated), generic (event handler attributes, constants, iterators of collections).
